description: SeekSat's ten popular satellites (ISS, Tiangong, Hubble, weather satellites and a few others): always all ten, in a fixed order, with aliases, page url and orbit data freshness. Not the full list: every other tool accepts any NORAD catalog number. To find another satellite by name use search_satellites; for one satellite's facts and TLE use get_satellite. Takes no input, reads only SeekSat's own catalog and does not fail. Read-only, free, no key needed; up to 120 requests per 60 seconds per IP address.
name: list_satellites
